reports.text: The Astros hired Brad Ausmus as their manager on Wednesday, reuniting the franchise with a familiar face while reigniting questions about the hierarchy of authority within its baseball operations department - www.nytimes.com/athletic/777...
Brad Ausmus is being hired as Astros manager
The latest on the Astros' managerial search - www.nytimes.com/athletic/777...
Astros GM Randy Flores confirmed that AGM Connor Huff has resigned to accept a position outside of baseball. Flores said the Astros will hire an AGM to replace him.

Asked if the manager search could be wrapped up this week, Astros GM Randy Flores said "I’m hopeful and I would expect that happens, but we’ll see.” Flores acknowledged that Albert Pujols, Brad Ausmus and Morgan Ensberg have interviewed. He declined to divulge much more.

Astros owner Jim Crane said he did interview some managerial candidates during the GM search process, but now that Randy Flores is hired, Crane said Flores will take over that search.

Oz Ocampo interviewed with Astros owner Jim Crane on Monday for an assistant general manager role, source tells @theathletic.com. Ocampo, who now works for the Colorado Rockies, worked for the Astros from 2012-20 and in 2022. Most of Ocampo’s work came in international scouting and acquisitions
